xAI/SpaceXAI announced that it will provide Anthropic access to **Colossus 1**, its AI supercomputer, to add capacity for Claude. The partnership also includes interest in developing multiple gigawatts of orbital AI compute.[1][2]

## Reported scope

- Anthropic is set to use the full Colossus 1 data-center capacity near Memphis—more than 300 MW and, according to Anthropic, over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs.[3][4]
- Anthropic said the capacity would begin becoming available within the month and would directly improve capacity for Claude Pro and Claude Max users.[4]
- Alongside this deal, Anthropic said it increased Claude Code’s five-hour rate limits for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise customers.[4]

## Commercial details

Later reporting, based on SpaceX’s SEC S-1 filing, said Anthropic would pay xAI about $1.25 billion per month through May 2029, with a discounted initial two-month period. The agreement reportedly permits either party to terminate with 90 days’ notice.[5]

The supplied x.ai page itself could not be fetched directly, so these details are corroborated from its search result plus Anthropic’s announcement and reporting.
